rationale: Price is at 93.1% of today's range and pressing against the session high ($213.73) with only 43 minutes remaining, creating unfavorable risk/reward for a long (minimal upside before resistance, forced liquidation risk). A short is equally unattractive: price is well above VWAP ($206.14), the 9-EMA is providing support at $212.73, and momentum in the last few candles is choppy/consolidating rather than rolling over. With today's realized loss already at -$73.64 and the stock digesting a large gap-down on mixed earnings, the setup lacks a clean directional edge to justify the spread cost and execution risk this late in the session.
